description: Defines classes and structures for managing cell group configurations in a scheduler, including resource pools for cells and UEs, and configuration management functions.

classes.name: du_cell_config_pool
classes.description: Manages configuration pools for a single cell, including cell configuration and BWP configurations.

classes.name: du_cell_group_config_pool
classes.description: Manages configurations for all entities (cells, UEs) within a cell group, providing methods to add and remove cells and UEs.

methods.name: du_cell_config_pool(const scheduler_expert_config&, const sched_cell_configuration_request_message&)
methods.description: Constructor initializing cell configuration pool with given scheduler config and request message.

methods.name: update_ue(const ue_cell_config&)
methods.description: Updates the configuration of a UE within the cell.

methods.name: add_bwp
methods.description: Adds a bandwidth part (BWP) configuration to the cell.

methods.name: add_cell
methods.description: Creates and adds a new cell configuration to the cell group.

methods.name: rem_cell
methods.description: Removes a cell and its resources from the cell group.

methods.name: add_ue
methods.description: Creates resources for a new UE during its creation.

methods.name: reconf_ue
methods.description: Reconfigures resources for an existing UE.
